hero.title: Ahonya a wɔda no adi
hero.lead: IATF yɛ adwuma wɔ baguam. Nhyehyɛe gyinaesi ahorow, mmara nsesae, nniso nsesa, ne dwuma a wɔde di dwuma ho ka no wɔ baabi a obiara tumi hu. kratafa yi kyerɛ baabi a kyerɛwtohɔ biara te ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so kenkan no.

items: Adwuma ho gyinaesi ahorow. Wɔkyerɛw gyinaesi ahorow a ɛfa gye a wobegye, akorae a wɔde bɛkora, ne nea wɔde bɛsan de ama afoforo no ho nsɛm te sɛ nsɛm a wotintim wɔ baabi a wɔkora ho nsɛm wɔ hɔ, na wɔtoto no tiawa wɔ baguam kyerɛwtohɔ mu. kyerɛwtohɔƐte sɛ dɛn?

Hwehwɛ kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow. Public request records wɔ IATF GitHub ahyehyɛde no mu, wɔ wɛbsaet yi so, anaa wɔn mmienu nyinaa. Records bɛtumi aka mfatoho, akyerɛkyerɛ mu, anaa ayɛ mfitiaseɛ no ho nhyehyɛɛ sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛtumi asusu hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔn nsa ka nsɛm a ɛho nhia ho. Disagree decisions are summarized into the public record when they affect a project or governance decision. Request records are excluded from search engine indexing where technically practical. View records: first publication request pending.
Kode ahorow no resesa. Nkyerεkyerεmu nsesae biara yε baguam asεm wɔ beae a wͻde wͻn ho hyε so no. Hwɛ IATF GitHub ahyehyɛdeƐte sɛ dɛn?
N'ahyehyɛde no sesae. Wodi nkrataa a wɔde ba dwumadibea hɔ no akyi bere a wɔde wɔn ho rehyɛ dwumadibea no mu no. IATF wɛbsaet Hwɛ nneɛma a wɔakora so no. kɔyɛ abakɔsɛm wɔ GitHub so.
Nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma. IATF ma adwuma no ho ka ba fam, na ɛrekyerɛw nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔman no mu ho ka. Efi afe 2022 mu no, nneɛma a wɔtaa de di dwuma titiriw no yɛ domain din.
Nhyehyɛe ho kyerɛwtohɔ. Akwankyerɛ anaa gyinaesi biara a wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ GitHub Discussions on the relevant repository view Nkɔmmɔbɔ wɔ IATF wɛbsaet adaka.

header.title: Nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma ho akatua ho kyerɛwtohɔ

paragraphs: IATF hyɛ da yɛ n'asetenam nneɛma nketenkete.Efi afe 2022 mu no, adwuma no ho ka a ɛtaa ba ne domain din.
Saa kyerɛwtohɔ yi nyɛ sikasɛm mu nkrataa a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu. Ɛyɛ nnwinnade a wɔde di dwuma a wɔde hwɛ IATF so no ho dawurubɔ krataa.
operatingCosts.footnote: Wubetumi de nkrataa a wo nsa aka no akyerɛkyerɛ mu anaa woatumi akyerɛw ato hɔ bere a wɔasiesie no. Adesrɛde ahorow, nneɛma a wɔde tua ka, ne ɛho nsɛm a ɛho nhia no nka baguam kyerɛwtohɔ no ho.

paragraphs: Wɔde nneɛma bi sie wɔ baguam kyerɛwtohɔ mu esiane atirimpɔw bi nti:
items: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyem no din ne wɔn ho nsɛm.
Ɛyɛ nkrataa a wɔkyerɛw kɔma ankorankoro a wɔde di dwuma de si asɛm bi so dua ansa na wɔagye atom, wɔapo, anaa wɔaka no tiawa.
Adesrɛs, telefon nɔma, ne nneɛma a ɛho nhia a ɛfa wo ho.
Biribiara a ɛbɛma wɔahu obi a ɔfa mfiri a wɔde boa adwuma no bi bere a onni ho kwan no.
Raw Discord nkɔmmɔbɔ, gye sɛ wɔde nkrataa pɔtee bi hyɛ da de kɔ baguam dwumadi ho kyerɛwtohɔ mu.

header.title: Aban no ne mmara nhoma a ɛhwɛ saa kyerɛwtohɔ yi so

paragraphs: Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wote ɔkwan a wɔfa so gye nnwuma to mu, wɔkora so, anaa wɔsan de ma no ase a, kenkan aban dwumadi no.
